skills.name: yl-channels-analytics

skills.name: yl-chatcut-landscape-interview-editor

skills.name: yl-chekhov-deep-writing

skills.name: yl-knowledge-build

skills.name: yl-knowledge-check

skills.name: yl-knowledge-distill
skills.description: 从本人完整原文中提炼可复用观点、概念、方法、案例和论述链，逐字回源，并先与现有知识原子做语义去重。

skills.name: yl-knowledge-expressions

skills.name: yl-knowledge-import

skills.name: yl-knowledge-ingest

skills.name: yl-knowledge-obsidian

skills.name: yl-knowledge-organize

skills.name: yl-knowledge-review-sync

skills.name: yl-knowledge-search

skills.name: yl-knowledge-sync

skills.name: yl-media
